datasheet_identity.title: PHPT61010NY, 100 V, 10 A NPN high power bipolar transistor

extraction_notes: Curve plots were examined in the supplied PDF, but no numeric curve points were retained because the plotted traces did not provide a defensible three-point digitization from the text extraction; no points were invented.
Absolute ratings and electrical-characteristics values are cited only where a tabulated value was readable.
Values are recorded as SI magnitudes; PNP polarity is represented by specs.polarity.
omission_reason: Characteristic plots are present, but the supplied rendering does not expose three or more exact numeric coordinates; emitting digitized points would require interpolation.
